name: Stafford County, VA
findings: Stafford County has 431 nonprofit organizations. 194 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 147 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Stafford County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 39 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 39 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Arts and cultural organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 7 arts and cultural organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do arts and cultural organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Few economic development organizations list membership
observations.text: 2 economic development organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 5 would.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.
